Priya (People Ops): Hey @Jordan — quick checklist for Aria (new PM) starting Mon 9am PT. Can you confirm these before EOD? :wave:
Jordan (Eng Manager): Sure — list them out and I'll check them off.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks. Essentials: laptop + charger, Slack invite, GH org access, Redwood Console read, AWS dev account, calendar 1:1 + team sync, pairing schedule for week1. Also any mandatory training?
Jordan (Eng Manager): I'll handle 1:1 + team sync invites. Mandatory: security basics + data handling (30 min each) — I can book for Tue afternoon.
Alex (Infra): I provisioned GitHub org access (repo: aria/*) and added to infra-team. Still need AWS role+session.
Sam (IT): Laptop order placed (Dell XPS), ETA Wed. If laptop delayed we have loaner laptops at HQ — ping me. Also created temporary Google account forwarding.
Maya (DevEx): Happy to run a 45m devstack + local run walkthrough Tue 11am. Sending invite now. I'll include a short doc: `devex/quickstart-aria.md`.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Can we set 30/60/90 expectations in a simple kickoff? My sketch: 30-day: product & codebase ramp, complete 2 reviews; 60-day: lead roadmap for 1 microfeature; 90-day: drive feature to prod.
Priya (People Ops): Perfect — I'll add those to the offer packet and send Onboarding Plan to Aria.
Alex (Infra): For AWS role: @Sam can you create `redwood-dev-ar` role and add Aria's SSO? If we need S3 read and limited EC2 describe.
Sam (IT): Yep — created request ticket `IT-4321`. ETA Fri for role. Will update once SSO link is live.
OnboardingBot: Welcome kit sent to aria@example.com — Slack invite, handbook link, parking pass (if HQ), and benefits doc.
Priya (People Ops): Small logistics note: first-week schedule suggestion (short):
```
Mon: 9am intro w/ Jordan + team, 11am HR benefits, 2pm security training
Tue: 10am product deep-dive, 11am devstack walkthrough (Maya)
Wed: paired coding session + infra tour (Alex)
Thu: stakeholder sync + 1:1 feedback loop
Fri: 30-day goals planning + retro
```
Jordan (Eng Manager): This looks good. I'll add a quick pairing slot for Thurs AM with Lina.
Maya (DevEx): I'll attach recorded microdemos and a small checklist: `checklist: set git user, clone repo, run tests, open PR template`.
Priya (People Ops): Who-to-ask quick list for Aria: @Jordan (team/questions), @Maya (dev environment), @Alex (infra access), @Sam (hardware/SSO), people-ops (payroll/benefits). I'll include as pinned message in welcome thread.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Confirmed. Thanks everyone — I'll post welcome message Mon 9am and add the 30/60/90 doc to the onboarding folder. :tada:
Priya (People Ops): Awesome. If anyone runs into blockers before Monday DM me. :slightly_smiling_face:
